input.sql:
SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2023-08-31', birth_date))) AS min_yas,
       MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2023-08-31', birth_date))) AS max_yas,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2023-08-31', birth_date))) AS medyan_yas,
       COUNT(*) AS musteri, COUNT(birth_date) AS dogum_tarihi_dolu
FROM customers

input.sql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT c.user_id,
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2023-08-31', c.birth_date)) AS yas,
         COALESCE(s.total_spent, 0) AS harcama,
         (s.user_id IS NOT NULL) AS siparisli
  FROM customers c
  LEFT JOIN customer_summary s ON s.user_id = c.user_id
), g AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN yas < 35 THEN '1) 23-34'
              WHEN yas < 45 THEN '2) 35-44'
              WHEN yas < 55 THEN '3) 45-54'
              WHEN yas < 65 THEN '4) 55-64'
              ELSE '5) 65-73' END AS yas_grubu, *
  FROM m
)
SELECT yas_grubu,
       COUNT(*) AS musteri_sayisi,
       SUM(CASE WHEN siparisli THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS siparisli_musteri,
       ROUND(AVG(harcama), 2) AS ort_toplam_harcama,
       ROUND(STDDEV(harcama), 2) AS std_sapma,
       ROUND(STDDEV(harcama) / SQRT(COUNT(*)), 2) AS std_hata,
       ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY harcama)::numeric, 2) AS medyan_harcama
FROM g
GROUP BY yas_grubu
ORDER BY yas_grubu
